rows.label: tlk4750016603_msg0001
rows.name:
A strange pair got off a ship
from Acedia.

rows.label: tlk4750016603_msg0002
rows.name:
They sat down here like they
were expecting someone to turn
up. Wonder if they ever did...?

rows.label: tlk4750016603_msg0003
rows.name:
The two of them talked
the whole time. The port is
usually quiet, so it was nice.

rows.label: tlk4750016603_msg0004
rows.name:
Hm? Oh! It's you! I enjoyed your
lively banter. Thanks for that.
